probe.ask: Reply with only the exact text of my previous message, nothing else.

notes: Confirmed against two real sessions in ~/.claude/projects/-Users-obafemi-Documents-dev-subway-context/ on 2026-11-15 (sessions 076d32c6-1a19-4a3c-bc2a-8f334c7491cd and 0c1994ec-74d5-4d94-99f6-820002a4b570): JSONL lives at {home}/.claude/projects/{cwd-with-every-non-[A-Za-z0-9]-char-replaced-by-'-'}/{session_id}.jsonl; file starts with an {ai-title} record carrying aiTitle+sessionId; user records carry parentUuid (null first), isSidechain:false, message:{role:'user',content:<str>}, uuid, ISO-ms-Z timestamp, userType:'external', cwd, sessionId, version, gitBranch (entrypoint is 'cli' for interactive runs; these headless runs used 'sdk-cli' plus extra fields promptId/promptSource/permissionMode, which our writer omits harmlessly); assistant records wrap message:{model,id:'msg_'+-suffixed id,type:'message',role:'assistant',content:[{type:'text',text}],stop_reason,stop_sequence,usage} with real usage token counts (we write zeros); files end with a {last-prompt} footer record with lastPrompt, leafUuid set to the last record uuid, and sessionId. Timestamps are UTC ISO with milliseconds and a trailing Z.
